characters.name: Aria Vale
characters.description: A travelling cartographer with an eye for hidden paths. She never leaves a mystery unmarked.

characters.name: Bren Ashford
characters.description: A former soldier tending a quiet roadside forge. His old allegiances are harder to put down than a hammer.

characters.name: Celia Voss
characters.description: A sharp-tongued antiquarian who collects forbidden stories. She is certain the past is still listening.

characters.name: Dorian Finch
characters.description: A charming courier who knows every back road in Emberreach. He always arrives on time, except when it matters most.

characters.name: Elara Quill
characters.description: A young scholar chasing the source of a recurring dream. Her notebooks contain maps to places that should not exist.

characters.name: Felix Rowan
characters.description: A soft-spoken innkeeper with a gift for remembering faces. His hospitality conceals a watchful mind.

characters.name: Gwen Thorne
characters.description: A reclusive herbalist who can read the moods of the forest. She trusts roots and rain more than people.

characters.name: Halden Rusk
characters.description: A veteran ranger pursuing a creature from an old folktale. Each trail seems to lead him closer to home.

characters.name: Isla Morrow
characters.description: A musician whose songs carry strange memories through the trees. She is searching for the voice that answers back.

characters.name: Jorek Fenn
characters.description: A cheerful trapper with an improbable talent for survival. He treats every danger as another good story.

characters.name: Kira Sable
characters.description: A quiet hunter who protects the paths around her village. Few know why she fears the sound of bells.

characters.name: Lucan Wren
characters.description: A wandering priest offering comfort to anyone who needs it. His faith is strongest when no one is watching.

characters.name: Maren Cole
characters.description: A daring sailor who hears warnings in the tide. She is looking for a ship that vanished years ago.

characters.name: Nico Reed
characters.description: A dockside fixer with friends in every tavern. He can find anything, provided you do not ask where it came from.

characters.name: Orla Vane
characters.description: A lighthouse keeper devoted to an impossible beacon. Every night, she waits for a light beyond the horizon.

characters.name: Perrin Crow
characters.description: A retired pirate who claims to have buried every treasure he stole. His map collection tells a different tale.

characters.name: Quinn Hale
characters.description: A fisher who knows the reefs better than any chartmaker. Their calm vanishes whenever the sea turns green.

characters.name: Rosa Lynn
characters.description: A bright-eyed apprentice mage fascinated by storms. She is convinced lightning has a language of its own.
